title: picked_screen
description: Metadata block written into metadata.json describing the chosen screen device.

av_index.description: AVFoundation device index used in ffmpeg -i N:audio

av_name.description: Raw locale-dependent device name from AVFoundation

bounds.description: x, y, width, height in global screen-pixel coordinates

is_main.description: True if this is the CGMainDisplayID() display

backing_scale.description: Retina backing scale factor (1.0 or 2.0 typical)

reason.description: How the screen was selected: default-main | explicit-int:N | display-pos:N | auto-front-app:AppName | auto-no-app-no-front-window:fallback-main
